measures.name: Load Factor
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Transported Passengers]), SUM('Main Data'[# Available Seats]))

measures.name: Performed vs Scheduled
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Departures Performed]), SUM('Main Data'[# Departures Scheduled]))

measures.name: Air Time %
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Air Time]), SUM('Main Data'[# Ramp-To-Ramp Time]))

measures.name: Carrier
measures.dax: IF(DISTINCTCOUNTNOBLANK('Main Data'[Carrier Name]) = 1, MAX('Main Data'[Carrier Name]), "Others")

measures.name: Air Time % (CH21)
measures.dax: DIVIDE(SUM('Main Data'[# Air Time]), SUM('Main Data'[# Ramp-To-Ramp Time]))

calculated_dimensions.qlik:
=if([Flight Type]='Domestic, US Carriers Only', 'Open',
if([Flight Type]='International, Foreign Carriers', 'Negotiating', 'Closed'))
calculated_dimensions.dax: SWITCH([Flight Type], "Domestic, US Carriers Only", "Open", "International, Foreign Carriers", "Negotiating", "Closed")

tables.Aircraft Types: Dimension containing information on aircrafts, including engine types and configuration and manufacturer

fields.%Aircraft Type ID: Primary key of the Aircraft Type dimension
fields.Aircraft Manufacturer: The name of the manufacturer of the aircraft, left blank when the aircraft is a generic type
fields.Aircraft Manufacturer Country: The country in which the manufacturer of the aircraft is based
fields.Aircraft Name Full: The full name of the aircraft
fields.Aircraft Name Abbreviated: The abbreviated name of the aircraft
fields.Aircraft Begin Date: The date when the aircraft was first entered into the database
fields.Aircraft End Date: The date when the aircraft was removed from the database
fields.Aircraft Engine Type: The engine type of the aircraft: Helicopter, Piston, Turbo-Prop or Jet
fields.Aircraft Number Of Engines: The number of engines on the aircraft

semantic_gaps: Origin / Destination Airports: the repo's Dimension Tables.mdb holds 6,209 airports each; the .qvw was reloaded from an older .mdb with 2,104 / 2,169 (inventory/row_count_exceptions.json). The repo tables are supersets of every airport ID Main Data uses, so measures are unaffected; only unassociated airport rows differ.
IF '$(vLoadMainData)' = 'Y' conditional load: the script always sets 'Y'; Main Data is always loaded.
STORE [Aircraft Types] INTO 'Aircraft Types Transformed.qvd' is an ETL side effect and is not migrated.
COMMENT TABLES / COMMENT FIELDS USING Comments.xls -> TMDL descriptions on the table and on every column of that name (QlikView comments a field in all tables).
MAPPING LOAD + ApplyMap('Map_Manufacturer_Country', MANUFACTURER, 'Unknown') -> Table.NestedJoin LeftOuter with 'Unknown' for unmatched manufacturers.
SubField(AC_GROUPNAME, ', ', 2) for a group name without a second part ('Helicopter/Stol') -> null.
Month (Flight Data dual) -> text column sorted by the hidden Month__num.
Calculated dimension (Flight Type deal status) -> calculated column 'Deal Status' on Flight Types.
Synthetic keys ($$SysTable 11-13) are not reproduced: every dimension joins Main Data on its one % key.

Report: one page per Qlik sheet; list boxes -> slicers on their sheet's page (field from the .qvw's DocumentSummary, sheet from the .qvw's object storage order). Charts, QlikView-only sheet objects (multi boxes, current selections, bookmark object, buttons, search object, container, statistics box, text objects) and layout are not migrated yet.
List box LB10 (Aircraft Type, sheet SH01): field 'Aircraft Type' is not in this app's data model; not migrated.
List box LB11 (Aircraft Group, sheet SH01): field 'Aircraft Group' is not in this app's data model; not migrated.
